Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Player

Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Player.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Player extends Object implements Serializable
The Player class represents a player in the game, managing the player's hand of cards, score, and interactions with the player's board.
